messages:
lee: Heads-up: ap-southeast1 showing elevated GPU pod evictions past 30m. Eviction rate ~2x.

aina: saw it. device_attach_duration_ms p95 spiked to ~15s and several nodes report nf_conntrack_count ~125k of 131072.

marco: Impacted = fractional/tiny-gang jobs with requiredDuringScheduling affinity + hard anti-affinity. Packing fails, scheduler preempts to free nodes.

lee: Quick mitigations?

marco: Start with small conntrack canary: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` via privileged daemonset on 10% nodes. If no improvement, flip tiny-gang anti-affinity to preferred for 30m.

aina: I'll roll the daemonset to 8 nodes now and watch `conntrack_drops` + `attach_latency`.

ops: If preemptions continue after 15m, ops will provision +1 on-demand GPU node in ap-southeast1 for 6h.

infra-bot: INC-2026-123 created: "apse1 conntrack pressure -> attach timeouts -> eviction churn" assigned to eng-platform.

lee: Action items: aina -> canary; marco -> scheduler soft-affinity patch ready to toggle; ops -> stand by for node. Post metrics in 10m.
